info.title: Multi-Agent Knowledge Assistant
info.description: Multi-tenant document intelligence: upload documents or URLs, ask questions, get cited answers.

post.description: Create a new tenant with its first admin. Disabled in production (use `python -m app.cli create-tenant`).

Exchange a refresh token (body or httpOnly cookie) for a new access token; the refresh token rotates on every use.
`optional=true` (used by the browser on page load): a missing or invalid token answers 200 {"authenticated": false} instead of 401, so signed-out visits stay quiet.
Revokes the access token and the whole refresh-token family of this login.

post.summary: Load the built-in sample documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, MD, TXT, JSON) into the current workspace so the labs have something to compare

get.summary: Concept catalog with the lab action that demonstrates each one

post.summary: The same question under different retrieval settings, side by side
Switch techniques on one by one and see what each addition changes

get.summary: The compiled LangGraph: nodes, edges (conditional ones flagged) and Mermaid source

post.summary: Run a question and watch every graph step: node, time, state keys written, checkpoints
Real langchain_core objects on your documents: retriever, LCEL chain, tool schema, parser, history
Literal name / phrase / ID search over the COMPLETE extracted text: counts per document, pages, paginated matches
Summaries of whole documents: short, detailed, executive, chapter, section
Compare two documents (sentence-level diff) or find contradictions between 2-6 documents

get.summary: What changed between a document version and its predecessor (or a chosen version)

post.summary: Web research (approved sources only). Answers cite web pages with origin=web, kept apart from your documents

delete.summary: Reset memory: delete all saved notes and the rolling summaries of your conversations (optionally the conversations too)

post.summary: Generate a report from your documents (synchronous; large documents can take a while)

get.summary: Your reports (admins see the whole organisation)
Tabular sources with their sheets and the SQL schema that /analytics/sql accepts
Column types, missing values, statistics, duplicate rows
Outliers in a numeric column (IQR or z-score)
Value per month / quarter / year with change, year-over-year and direction

post.summary: Run one validated read-only SELECT over the uploaded tables (sandboxed)
Natural-language question over the tables (fixed operations; a model-written validated SQL query when a model is configured)
Render a chart specification to PNG (for reports and downloads)

post.description:
Multi-file upload. Default: synchronous (validated, extracted, embedded and indexed before the response).
With ?async=true: files are queued for background workers and 202 + job ids are returned.
An identical file already indexed in the workspace is reported as `duplicate` (unless allow_duplicate); a file with the same name but
different content becomes a new VERSION of that document (older versions stay available for comparison but are not searched).

get.description: Documents visible to you (current versions; include_versions=true adds superseded ones). Paginated: limit/offset, total in X-Total-Count.

delete.description: Deletes text, chunks, vectors and the original file. Deleting the current version restores the newest older one; all_versions=true removes the document entirely.

get.description: Structured tables extracted from the source (spreadsheets, DOCX, HTML, PDF), each with its location.
Document type from a closed taxonomy (contract, invoice, policy, report, ...) with confidence and method (keywords | structure | llm).
Chronological list of dated events (the sentence around every date) with citations.
The extracted text at a citation location (+ the neighbouring passages) - used by the dashboard to preview a cited passage.
PNG of a PDF page with the cited text highlighted (PDF sources only; needs PyMuPDF).

schema.title: Response Versions Sources  Source Id  Versions Get

post.description: Roll back / forward: make this version the searchable one.

put.description: Document-level permissions: 'tenant' (everyone in the organisation), 'private' (owner + admins) or 'restricted' (owner + the listed users/roles + admins).

schema.title: Response Messages Conversations  Conv Id  Messages Get

post.description: Server-Sent Events: `step` (real graph progress), `token` (answer text pieces), `final` (full response incl. citations), `error`.

get.description: Checkpoint trail of the agent graph for this conversation (route, per-node trace, verification) - newest first.
Knowledge graph view: top entities; neighbours of `entity`; or the shortest connection between `entity` and `to`.

post.description: Speech-to-text for voice queries (OpenAI Whisper). Browsers can alternatively use client-side speech recognition.
Runs synchronously (a few seconds for the sample; up to 500 questions otherwise). Results are stored per tenant.

get.summary: Evaluation report as PDF, DOCX or XLSX (with the evaluated sources and generation time)

get.description: Effective configuration; secrets are masked and never returned.

delete.description: Irreversibly erase every document, vector, conversation, job and evaluation of the caller's tenant (users are kept).

put.description: Retention periods, approved web domains and message redaction for the whole organisation.

post.summary: Run retention sweeps and housekeeping now (dry run by default). Retention only touches YOUR tenant's data.
post.description: Same tasks as the scheduler, restricted to your organisation. Retention periods come from /admin/tenant-settings.

delete.description: Delete ALL sources of the current workspace (X-Session-ID) and its conversation memory.

source_ids.title: Source Ids
source_ids.description: Restrict to these sources (default: all in the session)

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: Continue this conversation (default: the user's latest one in the workspace)

retrieval.description: Per-request RAG strategy overrides (mode, rewrite, multi_query, hyde, rerank, filters, ...)

incognito.title: Incognito
incognito.description: Private question: no history is read, nothing is stored (no conversation, no messages, no memory notes used)

force_route.title: Force Route
force_route.description: Skip routing and use this agent

loc.title: Loc
loc.description: machine-readable location: page / sheet+row / paragraph / line / path ...

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: 'document' for your indexed sources, 'web' for external web pages (kept strictly separate)

memory_enabled.title: Memory Enabled
memory_enabled.description: False = private conversation: nothing is read from or stored in it from now on

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: Evaluate the built-in synthetic corpus in a throw-away workspace instead of your own documents

extended.title: Extended
extended.description: with sample=true: the v3 corpus (versions, comparison, contradictions, Hindi, analytics, parallel agents)

dataset.description: Your questions + gold passages (required unless sample=true); evaluated against the current workspace

term.title: Term
term.description: literal term for the tool demo (default: guessed from the question)

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: subset of: retention_documents, retention_conversations, retention_audit, retention_reports, cleanup_jobs, cleanup_tokens (default: all)

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: pdf, csv, xlsx, docx, txt, md, json, url, image

memory_enabled.title: Memory Enabled
memory_enabled.description: False = every question is private: no history is read, nothing is stored

long_term_memory.title: Long Term Memory
long_term_memory.description: True = saved notes relevant to a question are given to the model as context (never as evidence)

contains.title: Contains
contains.description: case-insensitive phrase that must occur in the retrieved chunk

RelevantRef.title: RelevantRef
RelevantRef.description: A gold passage: the source file and (optionally) page / sheet / row and a phrase the passage must contain.

source_ids.title: Source Ids
source_ids.description: documents to include (default: all accessible, up to 20)

params.title: Params
params.description: kind-specific: style/section (summary), mode (comparison: diff|contradictions), questions[] (research), term (exact_search), sheet/date_column/value_column/queries[] (analytics)

auto.title: Auto
auto.description: Let the agent graph choose the retrieval strategy for this question: candidate configurations are tried and the best-scoring one is used

self_rag.title: Self Rag
self_rag.description: Self-RAG loop: retrieve-or-not, passage relevance grading, sentence-level support critique with bounded regeneration

RetrievalOptions.title: RetrievalOptions
RetrievalOptions.description: Per-request overrides; anything left unset falls back to the server defaults (MKA_*).

section.title: Section
section.description: title (or part of it) for style=section

retention_days_documents.title: Retention Days Documents
retention_days_documents.description: delete documents older than N days (null = keep)

retention_days_audit.title: Retention Days Audit
retention_days_audit.description: audit trail is never kept for less than 30 days

web_allowed_domains.title: Web Allowed Domains
web_allowed_domains.description: empty = any public domain; otherwise only these domains (and sub-domains)

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Also set as an httpOnly cookie for browsers; API clients may store it

query.title: Query
query.description: question; may contain URLs to read. Without a URL the configured search provider is used
